title: Major exchange listings
description: Kaspa market access expanded through centralized exchange listings during 2022.

title: Hashrate expansion
description: Kaspa network hashrate expanded materially during 2023 as mining infrastructure matured.

title: Crescendo hardfork
description: Activated May 5, 2025 at approximately 15:00 UTC, transitioning mainnet from 1 to 10 blocks per second.

title: Toccata hardfork
description: Activated June 30, 2026 at approximately 16:15 UTC, introducing native covenant programming and infrastructure for based ZK applications.
